answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor can meet the 18% spend mandate and has a history of quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, while the second-source experience shows that dual sourcing materially reduces disruption risk during shortages. With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, use a guarded allocation rather than an immediate full transfer, preserving incumbent continuity while validating delivery performance and total cost. The test may not fully capture the low-cost quote’s savings or future capacity risk, so those uncertainties remain explicit.
